summary: Approvers see exactly what they approve, and a managed tenant can tell its provider's rows from its own.

new.title: Approvals list each assignment
new.text: A revoke approval now shows one readable line per assignment it covers. Raised from the revoke screen, it is filled in for you.

new.title: See where each row came from
new.text: On a managed tenant, every replicable record type now has a Source column, from the managing tenant or local, with counts in the header.

fixes.title: Fix buttons update the status at once
fixes.text: Every fix button and Fix all auto-fixable errors now updates the error count and Save gate immediately, so you no longer switch Block-Save off to commit.

fixes.title: Clearer replication wording
fixes.text: Replication wording no longer suggests a value missing from the picker, and rows carried along only as a dependency no longer need a ring.
